title: P=W in composite rank for fixed determinant
main_claim: For C of genus g>=2, composite n>=4, gcd(n,d)=1 and any L in Pic^d(C), P_k H^m(X^B) = W_{2k} H^m(X^B) = W_{2k+1} H^m(X^B) holds on the full rational cohomology of the fixed-determinant SL_n Higgs moduli space, including the Gamma-variant part. Proof outline: (i) an sl2 comparison criterion (Prop 2.x); (ii) relative hard Lefschetz and curious hard Lefschetz for one class e, both with center R; (iii) one degree -2 operator f' = pr_* A N^2 B pr^* that lowers perversity by 2 and Betti weight by 4, with [[f',e],e] = 8(-1)^b n(n-2)! delta e.

issues.location: Sec 2, Lemma norm:low-cohomology (variant part vanishes in degrees <=2)
issues.description: The proof cites dCMS2022 Prop 1.4 'in arbitrary rank' for H^i_var = P_{i-c} H^i_var with c = n(n-n/p)(g-1). I could not check the citation from the sources. The claim does follow independently from the endoscopic support statement: a kappa-part supported on A_gamma of codimension d_gamma forces perversity <= i - d_gamma. I recomputed the minimal codimension (n^2 - n^2/m)(g-1) over divisors m>1 of n, minimised at m = p; it equals c. So this is a citation-dependence note, not a gap.
issues.evidence: Codim A_gamma = (n^2-1)(g-1) - (r^2 m - 1)(g-1) with r = n/m, which matches c at m = p. Also c >= n^2/2 >= 8 > 2.

issues.description: The Lefschetz and Hodge-Tate transfer to the determinant-root cover depends on Mellit's final torus-affine stratifications having exactly the stated form. In the relative case over V with eigenvalue collisions, this is cited from the proof of Mellit Prop 8.7, not from a stated theorem. The cover argument itself is sound: finite etale covers of tori are tori, and the five-lemma passage on strict weight-graded localization sequences works. Correctness rests on that external input.
issues.evidence: [Mellit2025, proof of Proposition 8.7] cited for the relative stratification; the five-lemma step on Gr^W of compact-support long exact sequences checks.

coverage: Read all nine sections in full. Checked the sl2 comparison criterion: (ad E)^2 is injective on the weight -2 space, h0 is semisimple, and the eigenspace description of the filtrations follows. Checked the tensor Lefschetz lemma (Clebsch-Gordan, center of D_1 is g). Checked the flag correspondence: AB = (-1)^b n!, normal bundle T_pi^*, and dim Y_GL,t = 2R+2b+2g. Checked the dimension count -2chi(ParEnd_0) = 2R+2b. Checked the Riemann-Hilbert exponent and eigenvalue conventions, and nonresonance and subproduct conditions along both paths (v - a*ell and a*v). Checked the specialization lemma and the perverse shift rule (K -> K[-2] sends P_k to P_{k-2}). Checked the diagram-weight Gysin shifts, finiteness of graded monodromy, and N lowering weight by 2. Recomputed by hand the GRR jet sum T^{k*}e = e + k y + k^2 t_C, the permutation identity, a rank-2 flag pushforward check (2c1^2 - 8c2), the double commutator constant 8(-1)^b n(n-2)! delta, and the rescaling of f. The N-to-pullback convention sign is harmless because only N^2 enters. Not independently verified: the external inputs (Mellit strata, FHZ semistable reduction, HRV restriction theorem, Tubach MHM diagrams, dCMS Prop 1.4).
sibling_notes: Family 043 board was empty when this audit started. If siblings audit HMMS-style P=W papers: the perverse bound here costs nothing, since any degree-0 endomorphism over S x A integrated over S gives K -> K[-2]. All the real content is in the weight bound, which comes from N being the log of eigenvalue monodromy in Hodge-Tate diagram weights. Results also do not depend on the sign of N because only N^2 is used.
